title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology Pathogen Load Amplification

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Molecular pathogen load: Pathogen load — amplification technique asserted', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Same, restricted to Technique = << Molecular nucleic acid amplification technique. Shows the loss from a technique clause. Parts: LOINC enumeration (359, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
